notes: A dependency shipped as compiled CommonJS: Babel output (interop/extends/objectWithoutProperties helpers, `exports.x =`, `Object.keys(...).forEach` re-exports) and tsc output (inline `__importDefault`, `exports.default =`), analyzed from source through the CommonJS export model; a rollup UMD build whose factory receives `exports` and `require(...)`d dependencies as parameters; and `umd-join`, a UMD wrapper whose parameterless factory `return` becomes `module.exports` and whose body reads `arguments` through `[].slice.call`. `badge.js` also `require`s the installed `hasown` and `object.entries` (pure packages), whose `module.exports` functions run on the known props. `cjs-statics` is a pre-class constructor exposed as `module.exports = Registry` that also hangs itself and `defaultLimit` off the function (`Registry.Registry = Registry`, `module.exports.defaultLimit = 10`), so `import { Registry, defaultLimit }` resolves to those statics and its prototype methods run on the instance.
